editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison and realizing the world has changed, but the people you hate are still in power. That is exactly what happens to the main character here, a tough guy who just wants to get back on his feet. He quickly finds himself in a messy war with a drug dealer who used to be his rival behind bars. The whole movie feels gritty and real, like you are walking through the dirty streets of a city where one wrong move could get you shot. It is a classic crime story about pride and revenge that keeps you wondering who will survive the night.

You will really love the acting because the tension between the lead characters feels genuine. The action is punchy and the plot moves along quickly without getting bogged down. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of mob movies, the raw energy makes up for it.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a violent showdown where the main character finally settles the score with his enemy. After a series of betrayals and shootouts, the power struggle ends in blood. The protagonist manages to outsmart the drug dealer, but it comes at a high price. He wins the fight, but the cycle of crime shows that there are no real winners in this world, leaving you with a bittersweet feeling.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school crime thrillers and revenge stories.
